title: Large Wood-Fired Kiln - Resident Kiln Firer
source_quote: LARGE KILN: 90 cubic ft. Approximately 7-10 Days (5 day firing)
evidence_sentence: The pages describe a 90 cubic foot wood-fired Large Kiln where artists participate as resident kiln firers, managing approximately four to six 6-8 hour shifts.
evidence_quote: Our wood-fired ceramic kilns... The kiln requires over 100 hours to fire and a minimum of 5-6 artists to share the responsibilities.
summary: Rent space (5 or 10 cubic feet at 50% discount) in a 90-cubic-foot wood-fired kiln by committing to 4-6 shifts of 6-8 hours each during a 10-day firing cycle. Requires 50% deposit upfront.
commitment: 4-6 shifts × 6-8 hours each + 3 days loading + 10-day onsite residency
cost_text: 50% discount on kiln space (5 or 10 cubic feet) depending on experience and shift availability; 50% deposit required
